services.desc: Our queen/king raffle quilt was made by Becky Anderson and Lisa Anderson, employees of Washington County Bank (WCB) of Tekamah. Colors are shades of blue teal and white. The back and binding are blue with a butterfly pattern. WCB provided the fabric and the girls worked on it during their coffee breaks. We thank the bank and ladies for their continued support.
